source.policy: Recipe product and cookbook unlock evidence are copied from the public event-flag index; material quantities and output counts remain explicitly unknown when absent from that source.

ingredientSource.policy: Material names, per-craft quantities, and product output quantities are copied only from an exact public product/cookbook table match. Unmatched rows remain explicitly missing and never alter the unlock source.

dlcUnlockSource.policy: Only DLC cookbook/product pairs with exact unique official local entity matches are added; no material quantities or locations are inferred.
